a: Ku lw'eggulo lya 28 Apuli 1920, ng'aweza emyaka kkumi na musanvu, Nee yafukamira yekka mu kisenge kye oluvannyuma lwa wiiki nnyingi ez'obutateredde wansi w'okubuulira kw'omubuulizi w'enjiri omutambuze Dora Yu, era omulundi ogusooka n'asaba ng'ayita mu bibi bye okutuuka ku mirembe. Ettaka lyali liteekeddwateekeddwa nnyina, Lin Heping, eyakkirizibwa ennyo wansi w'obuweereza bwa Dora Yu ne kiba nti yajja awaka n'asaba mu bwetoowaze mutabani we ow'amalala okumusonyiwa olw'obubi bwe yali amukoze. Okuva ku kiro ekyo yeewaayo kyenkanyi eri Kristo n'eri okubuulira enjiri, ng'aleka omulimu omulungi ogw'ensi okusoma kwe okw'engeri ey'ebugwanjuba kwe kwali kumutegekedde.

Yazaalibwa ng'ayitibwa Ni Shu-tsu, naye mu 1925 yassa wabbali erinnya lye ery'okuzaalibwa n'atwala erinnya To-sheng, erijjukiza eddoboozi ly'ekide eky'omuti omukuumi w'ekiro ky'akuba mu ssaawa ez'ekizikiza ez'ekibuga eky'Echina. Omukuumi asigala nga mutunula ng'abalala beebase, ng'alangirira okuyita kw'ekiro era ng'alabula ku kabi, era mu Lungereza erinnya lyafuuka obulambulambu Watchman, kwe kugamba Omukuumi. Yamala obulamu bwe ng'aligoberera, ng'atunula era ng'akoowoola ekkanisa okuzuukuka olw'okujja kw'enkya.

q: Ekibiina "Ekisibo Ekitono" kye yatandikawo kyali ki?
a: Okuva mu ntandikwa y'emyaka gya 1920 Nee yakuŋŋaanya abakkiriza Abachina mu bibiina ebya kizaalirwa ebyali eby'eddembe okuva mu bufuzi bw'eddiini obw'ebweru — ekibiina ab'ebweru kye baayita Ekisibo Ekitono, so nga abagoberezi baakyo beeyita obulambalamba ekkanisa mu buli kifo. Yanywerera nti waaliwo ekkanisa emu yokka mu buli kibuga, era n'akola okulaba abakkiriza nga bagattibwa ku ttaka eryo mu kifo ky'okwawulibwa ebendera ez'ebugwanjuba eziyingizibwa. Nga gutandika n'abantu batono, omulimu gwakula mu myaka nga amakumi abiri okutuuka ku bibiina nga lusanvu n'abakkiriza nga obukumi musanvu, ne gutuuka ebweru wa China mu Philippines, Singapore ne Malaysia, era mu 1949 kye kyali ekibiina ky'Abaprotestanti ekisinga obunene mu ggwanga.

q: Bitabo bya Watchman Nee ki ebisinga okumanyibwa?
a: Omulimu gwe ogusinga okuwangaala ye The Normal Christian Life, ogwava mu bubaka bwe yawa mu Bulaaya mu 1938 ne 1939, ogunywerera nti obwana obwa buli mukkiriza si lutalo olutakoma wabula Kristo yennyini ng'abeeramu okuva munda. Era yawandiika The Spiritual Man mu juzuu ssatu, gwe yatandika mu 1926 ng'ali ku kitanda eky'obulwadde; Sit Walk Stand, okwekenneenya Abaefeso okulaga ekifo ky'omukkiriza, obulamu bwe obwa buli lunaku n'olutalo olw'omwoyo; ne The Release of the Spirit, ku kumenyebwa kw'omuntu ow'ebweru. Ebisinga obungi ku juzuu ze ezisukka mu amakumi ana byakuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva mu biwandiiko by'obubaka bwe obw'omu kamwa.

q: Yayigiriza ki ku musaalaba n'obulamu obw'omunda?
a: Nee yali, okusinga byonna, omunnyonnyozi w'obulamu obw'omunda, ng'ayawula wakati w'okusonyiyibwa kw'ebibi n'okununulwa okuva mu maanyi g'ekibi, era ng'ayigiriza nti Kristo eyakomererwa n'azuukira tasaanidde kwewuunyizibwa kyokka wabula ddala alina okubeeramu obulamu bwe yennyini ng'ayita mu mukkiriza. Yannyonnyola obuntu ng'omwoyo, emmeeme n'omubiri, era yakwatako nti obulamu bw'emmeeme obw'ebweru bulina okumenyebwa omwoyo ogubeera munda gulyoke guteebwe. Okuva ku musomesa we Margaret Barber yali amize obukakafu nti eky'okuddamu kya Katonda kimu kyokka eri buli bwetaavu bw'omuntu ye Mwana we — aweebwa mu kifo ky'omuntu wennyini Katonda gw'aggya mu kkubo.

Yee; okuva mu 1922 akafuba kaamuziggyanga emirundi n'emirundi, era oluvannyuma n'abonaabona n'obulwadde bw'olubuto obukadde n'obulwadde obuzibu obw'omutima. Yawandiika ekitundu kinene ekya The Spiritual Man ng'ali ku kitanda eky'obulwadde, era obunafu obuddiŋŋana bwamuwondera obulamu bwe bwonna obwasigalawo. Yagamba nti obuweereza bwe bwawaniriddwa si maanyi ga mubiri wabula obulamu bw'okuzuukira.

q: Witness Lee yali ani, era yakwatagana atya ne Nee?
a: Witness Lee yali omu ku bakozi banne ba Nee ab'okumpi ennyo, eyakola awamu ne Peace Wang okuva mu 1946 okuzzaawo ekkanisa ya Shanghai n'obuweereza bwa Nee obw'olwatu oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera mwe bwali bukomye. Okuziyiza kw'Abakomunisiti bwe kwajja, Lee yatwala ekibiina ky'ekkanisa mu buli kifo ebweru w'eggwanga, oluvannyuma n'akibunyisa mu Taiwan ne mu Bugwanjuba. Okuyita mu ye n'abalala, okuyigiriza kwa Nee kwatuuka ku bukumi n'obukumi bw'abakkiriza abataamusisinkana.

q: Kiki ekyatuuka ku Watchman Nee wansi w'ab'obuyinza Abakomunisiti?
a: Nga 10 Apuli 1952 yakwatibwa mu Shanghai, era oluvannyuma lw'emyaka ena ng'akuumibwa, omusango ogwa 1956 gwamusinga era ne gumusalira emyaka kkumi n'etaano egy'okusibwa n'okuddaabirizibwa ng'ayita mu mulimu. Ekibonerezo ekyo bwe kyaggwaako mu 1967 yasalirwa nti "tannaddaabirizibwa" era teyateebwa n'akatono, n'amala emyaka amakumi abiri egy'enkomerero egy'obulamu bwe mu kkomera, ng'aggyiddwako amakanisa ge yali ayimusizza. Mukyala we, Charity, ye yekka eyakkirizibwa okumukyalira, naye yakwatibwa era n'akubibwa Abakuumi Abamyufu, naye n'agaana okwegaana Kristo, era n'afa mu 1971, kumpi omwaka gumu gwokka nga ye tannafa.

q: Yafa atya, era kiki ekyazuulibwa oluvannyuma?
a: Nee yafiira mu kifo eky'okusiba eky'emirimu mu ssaza lya Anhui mu 1972, ng'aweza emyaka nkaaga mu munaana, ng'awangaazeeko mukyala we omwaka nga gumu. Ab'obuyinza baali babunyisizza obubaka nti yali yeegaanye enzikiriza ye mu kkomera, naye ab'eŋŋanda ze bwe bajja okukuŋŋaanya ebintu bye ebitono, wansi w'omutto gwe baasanga akapapula mu mukono gwe ye: "Kristo ye Mwana wa Katonda eyafa olw'okununula aboonoonyi n'azuukira oluvannyuma lw'ennaku ssatu … Nfa olw'okukkiriza kwange mu Kristo." Mu emu ku bbaluwa ze ez'oluvannyuma, eyawandiikibwa ennaku amakumi asatu mu munaana nga tannafa, yali awandiise ebigambo ebyangu: "Nkuuma essanyu lyange."
